title: World Bloom — Turning Pain Into Drive — Episode5 The Lines Begin to Cross

meta.Episode: Episode5 — The Lines Begin to Cross
meta.Event Outline: The members of Vivid BAD SQUAD check in on the tree growing in the plaza of their SEKAI. Suddenly, each of them is thrown into a dream showing them a different life, in a world where their paths diverged...

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line:
Whoa, you're really here?
When did you get back to Japan?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Just last night.
I couldn't sleep because there was so much turbulence during my flight.

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line:
Haha. But you seem fine despite that.
I guess it's a testament to your stamina.

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line:
Aoyagi also came back to Japan!
What country was it? Australia?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Austria. I'm currently living in Vienna.

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line:
Yeah, there!
And Akito's over in the US. It's so amazing what you guys are doing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm singing over in the States right now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I had no idea you were still singing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Is he implying that I'm still chasing after a childish dream?)

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we're all here, let's head over to the diner, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line: Still, I sort of can't believe that you're taking time off from school to be in America.

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line: Do you miss Japanese food at all?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh... No, I haven't been feeling all that homesick. I mean, they have Japanese food over there.

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line: Really? You're living with your big brother right now, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line: That's nice. I'd be so scared if I had to live abroad all by myself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, his support has been enormous.

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line: Hey, don't you wanna trade stories with Aoyagi about what it's like to live overseas...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line:
Well, I mean...
You guys used to be best buds before, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, how have things been for you lately?

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line:
Oh, you wanna know?
After a certain someone decided to leave, we've been having a ton of trouble finding people who are willing to lend the soccer team a hand.

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Aoyagi, you used to play music pretty seriously.

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line: Does that mean you're going to a music school now?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I'm attending a normal school.

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line: What?! Really? But you're such an amazing singer!

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line: Yeah! You're giving it up for good? That seems like such a waste.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I appreciate you saying that, and I'm sorry to disappoint you, but... I've made my decision.

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line: Alright... But I guess that's only natural if you found something else you wanna do.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can't keep going after this childish dream.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I've got no clue what he's thinking...)

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line:
Man, that was great!
It was so fun to hang out like this again!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Oh, it's already this late?

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line: We really chatted up a storm, huh?

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line:
We should do this again sometime!
We'll make sure to invite you two again, Akito, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. I'll make an effort to attend if I'm free.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, if I can make it.

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line: That's a promise! Anyway, see you guys!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's my last chance for us to talk.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He probably sees me as a complete stranger now, but...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I've been gone for a while, so I'm gonna go for a stroll before I head home. Later.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Can we talk for a minute?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There's something I need to tell you.
